## PKAtlas 2.7 · iOS 27.2 unsigned IPA

**Open-source privacy-first iOS edition.** Offline-by-default; users manually configure their own HTTPS backend. No private origin address, device credentials, personal data or IP embedded in this public artifact.

### Included
- Pharmacokinetic curve and mathematical inverse explorer
- GitHub-only anonymous release checks; independent Ed25519-signed metadata
- Locally encrypted records; optional self-hosted HTTPS sync after explicit setup
- No automatic IPA installation; verify SHA-256 and sign with your own provisioning profile

**SHA-256**: `d595203bd582bbf7672563fd362ef82032438cd04388dd103159d6f29f760504`

**Safety**: models are approximations, not clinical dosing advice. GitHub can see client egress IP; use a privacy network if required.

### Machine-verified release notice
